item.title: TorchTPU: Running PyTorch Natively on TPUs at Google Scale
item.description:
📝 This is where PyTorch comes in: the PyTorch toolchain already creates a consistent, widely-used interface over other device types. Achieving this required an entirely new approach to how PyTorch interacts with the TPU compiler and runtime stack. By integrating at this deep level, we are able to fully prioritize the eager execution experience developers expect from PyTorch.
🔗 Read more: https://developers.googleblog.com/torchtpu-running-pytorch-natively-on-tpus-at-google-scale/
